title: Building real-world tech skills: New $294K grant transforms UNI computer science learning
summary_en: A $294,000 grant from the Roy J. Carver Charitable Trust is helping UNI’s Department of Computer Science create state-of-the-art virtual computing environments where students can gain hands-on experience in cybersecurity, networking, system administration and more.
